# Code of Conduct

Underthread follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind, assume good faith, welcome newcomers and people writing in their second language (English or Chinese are both fine here), and keep criticism about the work, not the person. Harassment, insults, and publishing other people's private information are not accepted.

## Reporting

If someone's behaviour in this project's spaces bothers you, contact the maintainer privately through GitHub: open a private report with the **Report a vulnerability** button on the repository's Security tab and say it is a conduct report. There is no email address; nothing you send that way is public. Reports are handled confidentially. The maintainer may remove comments, issues or contributions, or block people, who break this code.
